component.name: TallyForth
component.summary: Tape calculator with notes alongside the numbers

description.p: TallyForth is an adding-machine calculator with a paper tape. It keeps a running tally and lets you write a note next to every number, so a budget, a quote or a pile of receipts stays readable after you've added it up.

ul.li: Type a note and an amount together, such as "Potato salad $55"
The working stays on the tape, such as 2 × 55 = 110.00
Side calculations that aren't added to the tally
Subtotals and totals, with cents that always add up
Edit, delete and drag lines to reorder them, and everything recalculates
Paste a column of numbers from a spreadsheet or bank statement
Several tapes in tabs, saved automatically

screenshot.caption: A tape with notes, a running balance and the keypad
